messages:
anna: Quick sync — we need to finalize the interoperability test schedule + embargo windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Objective: agree ship dates, lab access, and press timing. I added a draft calendar in the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/partners/interop-calendar
marcus: I can take the test calendar and perf gates. Proposal: three phases — vendor smoke, SI lab validation, and public marketplace tile. Each phase has a must-pass checklist.
jia: I'll own the compatibility matrix and the harness. Need exact SW stacks and preferred runtime digests from vendors so CI runs are reproducible. Also want a short list of models (tiny/med/large) for the initial sweep.
simon: Vendor side: we can provide runtime images and signed digests, plus pre-release firmware for SI labs under NDA. Example tags: vendor/h100:2026-04-20@sha256:bbb111, vendor/gaudi:2.3@sha256:ccc222. We recommend testing MIG 7g and 2x3g patterns for H100.
marcus: Good. For perf gates I'll publish baseline numbers and regression thresholds (10% perf regression triggers halt). Also will include p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec.
jia: For harness let's standardize a YAML job that CI can run. Example: 
```
image: vendor/h100:2026-04-20@sha256:bbb111
model: gpt-3b
device: H100
batch: 8
seq_len: 1024
```
And a small quality smoke of 200 completions to check stability.
deploy-bot: Reminder: partnerships interop sync scheduled tomorrow 2026-04-22 09:00 PDT — calendar invite sent.
simon: Shipping ETA for SI kits: dispatch 2026-04-27, arrive regionally by 2026-05-03. NDA link posted to vendor portal DM. We'll open a support alias for the lab window.
anna: Action owners: Marcus — perf gates + spreadsheet (EOD today). Jia — matrix + harness YAML (EOD today). Simon — signed digests + NDA + shipping ETA (by tomorrow noon). I'll draft embargo windows and press ops cadence (by tomorrow EOD).
marcus: I'll include failure-mode taxonomy we should capture (OOM, kernel panic, miscompiled kernels, thermal throttling) and a short post-test checklist.
jia: We'll add CI alerts on regression and auto-upload artifacts (logs, kernel messages, perf traces) to S3 for analysis.
simon: Note: B200 requires BIOS v2.1 and PCIe 4 forced mode for stable runs. I'll add that to the recommended config doc.
anna: One more: recommend we hold a dry-run with internal SRE next week to validate lab access and VLAN provisioning. If that's all OK we'll lock the public announce window. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
